description_excerpt: About the Role We are looking for a hands-on Senior DevOps Engineer to strengthen our platform engineering team. In this role you will design, build, and operate cloud infrastructure on Azure or GCP, drive CI/CD automation, and embed GitOps practices that let product teams ship with confidence. You will work closely with infrastructure, security, and application teams — translating complex technical solutions into measurable business outcomes while raising the DevOps bar across the organization.
